album.title: Radif of Persian Music on Setar I

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on B2 and dwells most on Gb in Gushe Araq. The line peaks at Gb4 (374.5 Hz) at 1:17.8. It closes on Ds4, not the tonic (E4 → E4 → E4 → Ds4 → B2 → Ds4).
